title: 潛盾發進與到達端止水~Water sealing at shield launch and reception
focus: 以始發到達介面、地層水文和暫態受力驗證止水轉換~Verify launch and reception sealing transitions through interfaces, hydrogeology and temporary load paths
summary: 本課聚焦以始發到達介面、地層水文和暫態受力驗證止水轉換。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on verify launch and reception sealing transitions through interfaces, hydrogeology and temporary load paths. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 始發到達控制體~Launch and reception control volumes
units.title: 始發到達控制體~Launch and reception control volumes
units.mechanism: 穿越井壁時，機器、井體和地層之間的支護與止水邊界會改變，不能只檢查最終貫通狀態。應按位置畫出每個階段仍存在的屏障和力流，特別辨識暫時只剩單一道防護的區間。 假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。 屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。~Crossing a shaft wall changes support and sealing boundaries among machine, shaft and ground. Checking only final breakthrough misses transitions; map barriers and load paths by position, identifying intervals with only one remaining barrier. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition. A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition.
units.verify: 用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。~Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked.
units.failure: 屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。~A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked.
units.misconception: 最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。~Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄始發到達控制體的資料來源與適用條件。用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for launch and reception control volumes. Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing.

units.anchor: 水頭基準與外水力~Head datum and external water force
units.title: 水頭基準與外水力~Head datum and external water force
units.mechanism: 井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。壓力計高程與測段連通性需清楚，不能把井深或某個遠處水位直接當成所有位置的水頭。 假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。 把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。~The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ. Gauge elevation and interval connectivity matter; neither shaft depth nor one distant water level represents every location. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation. Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation.
units.verify: 用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。~Build head ranges from multilevel observations with a common elevation datum and pumping timeline; geotechnical and structural engineers confirm adverse water conditions and uniform-load assumptions rather than treating the example as a test pressure. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects.
units.failure: 把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。~Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects.
units.misconception: 井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。~Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄水頭基準與外水力的資料來源與適用條件。用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for head datum and external water force. Build head ranges from multilevel observations with a common elevation datum and pumping timeline; geotechnical and structural engineers confirm adverse water conditions and uniform-load assumptions rather than treating the example as a test pressure.

units.anchor: 處理體連續性與薄弱通道~Treated-ground continuity and weak paths
units.title: 處理體連續性與薄弱通道~Treated-ground continuity and weak paths
units.mechanism: 地層處理體的作用取決於連續性和與井壁的接合，平均強度或滲透性不能排除細小貫通通道。幾何覆蓋、施工偏差和天然透水夾層須一起審查，避免把處理體當成理想均質方塊。 假設串聯兩層各厚1 m，k1=10⁻⁶、k2=10⁻⁸ m/s，法向等效k=2/(10⁶+10⁸)=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s；旁通不適用。 高強度區樣本容易取得，弱通道卻可能被漏採；串聯低透水公式若實際有旁通便失效，開口後集中滲流可能遠高於平均材料估算。~A treated block depends on continuity and its interface with the wall. Average strength or permeability does not exclude a narrow connected path, requiring geometry, construction deviations and permeable interbeds to be assessed together. Assume two 1 m layers in series with k1=10⁻⁶ and k2=10⁻⁸ m/s; normal equivalent k=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s, excluding bypass paths. Strong areas are easier to sample while weak paths may be missed. A series-layer calculation fails in the presence of bypass, and concentrated inflow can greatly exceed the average-material estimate.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設串聯兩層各厚1 m，k1=10⁻⁶、k2=10⁻⁸ m/s，法向等效k=2/(10⁶+10⁸)=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s；旁通不適用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume two 1 m layers in series with k1=10⁻⁶ and k2=10⁻⁸ m/s; normal equivalent k=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s, excluding bypass paths.
units.verify: 將處理範圍、鑽孔軌跡及驗證試驗放在三維坐標，特別查井壁接觸與邊緣；地工工程師需說明取樣能否排除連通弱帶，不能只以少數高強度試件代表整個體積。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：高強度區樣本容易取得，弱通道卻可能被漏採；串聯低透水公式若實際有旁通便失效，開口後集中滲流可能遠高於平均材料估算。~Integrate treatment geometry, borehole paths and verification in three dimensions, focusing on wall contact and edges; engineers justify whether sampling excludes connected weak zones rather than representing the whole block with a few strong specimens. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Strong areas are easier to sample while weak paths may be missed. A series-layer calculation fails in the presence of bypass, and concentrated inflow can greatly exceed the average-material estimate.
units.failure: 高強度區樣本容易取得，弱通道卻可能被漏採；串聯低透水公式若實際有旁通便失效，開口後集中滲流可能遠高於平均材料估算。~Strong areas are easier to sample while weak paths may be missed. A series-layer calculation fails in the presence of bypass, and concentrated inflow can greatly exceed the average-material estimate.
units.misconception: 少數高強度處理體試件可以排除所有貫通薄弱通道。~A few strong treated-ground specimens exclude every connected weak pathway.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄處理體連續性與薄弱通道的資料來源與適用條件。將處理範圍、鑽孔軌跡及驗證試驗放在三維坐標，特別查井壁接觸與邊緣；地工工程師需說明取樣能否排除連通弱帶，不能只以少數高強度試件代表整個體積。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for treated-ground continuity and weak paths. Integrate treatment geometry, borehole paths and verification in three dimensions, focusing on wall contact and edges; engineers justify whether sampling excludes connected weak zones rather than representing the whole block with a few strong specimens.

units.anchor: 滲流梯度與尺度~Seepage gradient and scale
units.title: 滲流梯度與尺度~Seepage gradient and scale
units.mechanism: 水頭差除路徑長形成平均梯度，真正最短路徑可能沿井壁界面或裂縫。提高處理厚度不一定同比降低局部梯度，若缺陷使路徑縮短，流失風險需用連通幾何與土性共同評估。 假設水頭差10 m、有效路徑5 m，i=2；若裂縫路徑僅1 m則i=10，未計三維流場。 以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。~Head difference over path length gives a mean gradient, but the shortest route may follow a wall interface or crack. Greater treatment thickness does not proportionally reduce local gradients if a defect shortens the actual flow path. Assume head difference 10 m over effective path 5 m, giving i=2; a 1 m crack path gives i=10, before three-dimensional flow effects. Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設水頭差10 m、有效路徑5 m，i=2；若裂縫路徑僅1 m則i=10，未計三維流場。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume head difference 10 m over effective path 5 m, giving i=2; a 1 m crack path gives i=10, before three-dimensional flow effects.
units.verify: 由地質、接合面與孔壓觀測建立可行流路，對比完好體及局部缺陷情境；試驗和模型應由地工工程師確認尺度，梯度算例不能作現場注水或開口許可。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。~Construct plausible paths from geology, interfaces and pressure observations and compare intact and defective scenarios; geotechnical engineers validate test scale, and the gradient exercise does not authorize injection or opening work. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition.
units.failure: 以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。~Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition.
units.misconception: 處理體總厚度永遠就是地下水能走過的最短路徑。~The full treated-block thickness always equals the shortest possible groundwater path.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄滲流梯度與尺度的資料來源與適用條件。由地質、接合面與孔壓觀測建立可行流路，對比完好體及局部缺陷情境；試驗和模型應由地工工程師確認尺度，梯度算例不能作現場注水或開口許可。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for seepage gradient and scale. Construct plausible paths from geology, interfaces and pressure observations and compare intact and defective scenarios; geotechnical engineers validate test scale, and the gradient exercise does not authorize injection or opening work.

units.anchor: 止水環壓縮與偏心~Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity
units.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心~Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity
units.mechanism: 始發到達止水裝置需適應機器外形與偏心，環狀接觸不均時局部壓縮不足可能先漏。機器姿態與井口幾何是共同介面，不能只由止水材料單方證書判定整體可用。 假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。 機器偏斜可能一側擠壞密封而另一側失去接觸，平均壓縮仍正常；若以增加單側作用力補救而未審查，還可能加劇井口或機器偏位。~Launch or reception seals must accommodate machine shape and eccentricity. Uneven annular contact leaves locally undercompressed zones, making machine pose and opening geometry a shared interface beyond what a material certificate alone can establish. Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing. Misalignment can overcompress one side and lose contact on the other despite a normal mean. An unreviewed unilateral correction may worsen opening or machine displacement rather than restore a compatible interface.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing.
units.verify: 將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：機器偏斜可能一側擠壞密封而另一側失去接觸，平均壓縮仍正常；若以增加單側作用力補救而未審查，還可能加劇井口或機器偏位。~Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Misalignment can overcompress one side and lose contact on the other despite a normal mean. An unreviewed unilateral correction may worsen opening or machine displacement rather than restore a compatible interface.
units.failure: 機器偏斜可能一側擠壞密封而另一側失去接觸，平均壓縮仍正常；若以增加單側作用力補救而未審查，還可能加劇井口或機器偏位。~Misalignment can overcompress one side and lose contact on the other despite a normal mean. An unreviewed unilateral correction may worsen opening or machine displacement rather than restore a compatible interface.
units.misconception: 平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。~Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄止水環壓縮與偏心的資料來源與適用條件。將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for sealing-ring compression and eccentricity. Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes.

units.anchor: 角度誤差與穿越長度~Angular error through the opening
units.title: 角度誤差與穿越長度~Angular error through the opening
units.mechanism: 機器中心位置正確但姿態偏斜，沿穿越長度仍會產生側向偏差，影響止水接觸與井壁淨距。坐標點與機器軸線必須一起審查，不能以某一瞬間中心點在容許圈內就接受全部幾何。 假設穿越長10 m、角偏0.2°，側向偏差10tan0.2°=34.91 mm；非允許偏角。 長機身的小角偏可在後方形成大碰撞風險，目標點桿臂設定錯誤又會讓畫面中心看似正確；若未核對整體輪廓，止水和結構都受影響。~A correctly located center with wrong attitude develops lateral error along the crossing length, affecting contact and clearance. Review position and axis together rather than accepting the whole geometry from one center point inside a tolerance circle. For assumed crossing length 10 m and angular error 0.2°, lateral deviation is 10tan0.2°=34.91 mm, not an allowable angle. A small angular error produces large rear-envelope displacement on a long machine, while wrong target lever arms make the displayed center appear correct. Unchecked full-envelope geometry threatens both sealing and structure.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設穿越長10 m、角偏0.2°，側向偏差10tan0.2°=34.91 mm；非允許偏角。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed crossing length 10 m and angular error 0.2°, lateral deviation is 10tan0.2°=34.91 mm, not an allowable angle.
units.verify: 以獨立測量核對機器前後基準點和井口軸線，將位置、俯仰及偏航轉成最小淨距；測量與設備工程師確認坐標轉換和誤差包絡，不能只以導航畫面單點顯示取代。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：長機身的小角偏可在後方形成大碰撞風險，目標點桿臂設定錯誤又會讓畫面中心看似正確；若未核對整體輪廓，止水和結構都受影響。~Independently survey front and rear references and the opening axis, converting position, pitch and yaw into minimum clearance; survey and equipment engineers verify transformations and uncertainty rather than relying on one navigation-screen point. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A small angular error produces large rear-envelope displacement on a long machine, while wrong target lever arms make the displayed center appear correct. Unchecked full-envelope geometry threatens both sealing and structure.
units.failure: 長機身的小角偏可在後方形成大碰撞風險，目標點桿臂設定錯誤又會讓畫面中心看似正確；若未核對整體輪廓，止水和結構都受影響。~A small angular error produces large rear-envelope displacement on a long machine, while wrong target lever arms make the displayed center appear correct. Unchecked full-envelope geometry threatens both sealing and structure.
units.misconception: 機器中心點對準就不需要再檢查俯仰偏航和穿越長度。~A correctly positioned machine center removes the need to check pitch, yaw and crossing length.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄角度誤差與穿越長度的資料來源與適用條件。以獨立測量核對機器前後基準點和井口軸線，將位置、俯仰及偏航轉成最小淨距；測量與設備工程師確認坐標轉換和誤差包絡，不能只以導航畫面單點顯示取代。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for angular error through the opening. Independently survey front and rear references and the opening axis, converting position, pitch and yaw into minimum clearance; survey and equipment engineers verify transformations and uncertainty rather than relying on one navigation-screen point.

units.anchor: 反力架與暫態傳力~Reaction frame and temporary load paths
units.title: 反力架與暫態傳力~Reaction frame and temporary load paths
units.mechanism: 始發推進反力須經核准的支承系統傳到井體或基礎，受力位置與剛度會影響機器對準。到達時支承重新分配也可能形成局部荷載，永久井壁分析不能自動涵蓋這些集中暫態作用。 假設反力4 MN由4個理想等剛度支點均分，平均1 MN/點；偏心及不等剛度須另算。 單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。~Launch reaction transfers through approved supports into shaft or foundation, with location and stiffness affecting alignment. Reception redistributes support and can create concentrated loads not automatically covered by permanent shaft-wall analysis. Assume 4 MN reaction shared by 4 ideally equal-stiffness supports; the mean is 1 MN each, with eccentricity and stiffness differences assessed separately. A gap at one support overloads others, and frame rotation transfers alignment error to the seal interface. Total reaction alone can conceal both localized structural distress and machine displacement.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設反力4 MN由4個理想等剛度支點均分，平均1 MN/點；偏心及不等剛度須另算。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 4 MN reaction shared by 4 ideally equal-stiffness supports; the mean is 1 MN each, with eccentricity and stiffness differences assessed separately.
units.verify: 核對實際反力點、連接及井體受力圖，利用合格分析或量測檢查分配與變形；臨時工程設計者簽認受力路徑和階段，不以總承載除支點數當完整結構驗證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。~Check actual reaction points, connections and shaft load paths with qualified analysis or measurements of sharing and movement; temporary-works designers approve stages rather than treating total capacity divided by support count as full verification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A gap at one support overloads others, and frame rotation transfers alignment error to the seal interface. Total reaction alone can conceal both localized structural distress and machine displacement.
units.failure: 單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。~A gap at one support overloads others, and frame rotation transfers alignment error to the seal interface. Total reaction alone can conceal both localized structural distress and machine displacement.
units.misconception: 總反力除支點數就是每個實際支點的真實受力。~Total reaction divided by support count equals the actual force at every support.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄反力架與暫態傳力的資料來源與適用條件。核對實際反力點、連接及井體受力圖，利用合格分析或量測檢查分配與變形；臨時工程設計者簽認受力路徑和階段，不以總承載除支點數當完整結構驗證。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for reaction frame and temporary load paths. Check actual reaction points, connections and shaft load paths with qualified analysis or measurements of sharing and movement; temporary-works designers approve stages rather than treating total capacity divided by support count as full verification.

units.anchor: 觀測鏈與過渡確認~Observation chains and transition checks
units.title: 觀測鏈與過渡確認~Observation chains and transition checks
units.mechanism: 過渡區的量測須同時涵蓋水、土、機器和井體，單一無漏水觀察不能證明沒有地層流失。每項資料要對齊機器位置與階段，讓任何偏離可以回到具體屏障與責任人。 假設6項關鍵觀測中5項有效、1項失聯，有效率83.3%；失聯不能填成正常零值。 井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。~Transition monitoring covers water, ground, machine and shaft. No visible leakage alone does not prove absence of ground loss. Align all observations with machine position and stage so deviations map to a barrier and responsible owner. If 5 of an assumed 6 critical observations are valid and 1 is offline, validity is 83.3%; missing data must not be filled as a normal zero. Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection. Unsynchronized records can reverse event order and direct the response to the wrong transition stage.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設6項關鍵觀測中5項有效、1項失聯，有效率83.3%；失聯不能填成正常零值。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 5 of an assumed 6 critical observations are valid and 1 is offline, validity is 83.3%; missing data must not be filled as a normal zero.
units.verify: 以模擬事件演練壓力、流量、濁度、位移和姿態資料的同步比對，核對失聯警報與備援；主管工程師指定每階段必要證據，未取得時依既定計畫處理而非以多數正常通過。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。~Rehearse synchronized pressure, flow, turbidity, movement and pose using simulated events and verify dropout alarms and backups; engineers define stage-specific evidence, with missing data handled by the approved plan rather than majority-normal voting. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection. Unsynchronized records can reverse event order and direct the response to the wrong transition stage.
units.failure: 井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。~Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection. Unsynchronized records can reverse event order and direct the response to the wrong transition stage.
units.misconception: 井內沒有看見漏水就證明地層不可能向其他空間流失。~No visible shaft leakage proves that ground cannot be flowing into other spaces.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄觀測鏈與過渡確認的資料來源與適用條件。以模擬事件演練壓力、流量、濁度、位移和姿態資料的同步比對，核對失聯警報與備援；主管工程師指定每階段必要證據，未取得時依既定計畫處理而非以多數正常通過。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for observation chains and transition checks. Rehearse synchronized pressure, flow, turbidity, movement and pose using simulated events and verify dropout alarms and backups; engineers define stage-specific evidence, with missing data handled by the approved plan rather than majority-normal voting.

units.anchor: 停留情境與既定回應~Hold scenarios and predetermined responses
units.title: 停留情境與既定回應~Hold scenarios and predetermined responses
units.mechanism: 過渡區若停留，材料時間效應、外水與支承狀態仍持續變化，所以停留情境需在事前設計。回應必須由核准專業團隊決定，學徒的角色是理解何種證據使原模型失效，並正確通報。 假設資料更新間隔2 min、傳輸3 min、確認5 min，單次資訊等待尺度10 min；不是允許停留時間。 把資料延遲當成工程可等待時間會混淆量測能力與地層容忍度，長停留下材料變化又可能使原驗證失效；未明示此界線會造成錯誤信心。~During a transition hold, material aging, water loading and support conditions continue changing. Plan such scenarios beforehand, with responses controlled by approved specialists; the learner identifies evidence invalidating the model and communicates it correctly. Assume update interval 2 min, transmission 3 min and confirmation 5 min; information delay totals 10 min, not an allowable hold duration. Treating information latency as permissible engineering delay confuses monitoring ability with ground tolerance. Material changes during a long hold can also invalidate earlier verification, creating false confidence if that boundary is unstated.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設資料更新間隔2 min、傳輸3 min、確認5 min，單次資訊等待尺度10 min；不是允許停留時間。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume update interval 2 min, transmission 3 min and confirmation 5 min; information delay totals 10 min, not an allowable hold duration.
units.verify: 審查停留期間所需的連續觀測與備援通訊，演練責任人接收、核對和升級流程；正式停留、復工或維護仍依個案核准方案，不能由算例延遲自行制定時間限制。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把資料延遲當成工程可等待時間會混淆量測能力與地層容忍度，長停留下材料變化又可能使原驗證失效；未明示此界線會造成錯誤信心。~Review continuous observations and backup communication during holds and rehearse acknowledgment and escalation; stopping, restarting and maintenance remain governed by the approved project plan, not a limit derived from illustrative data latency. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating information latency as permissible engineering delay confuses monitoring ability with ground tolerance. Material changes during a long hold can also invalidate earlier verification, creating false confidence if that boundary is unstated.
units.failure: 把資料延遲當成工程可等待時間會混淆量測能力與地層容忍度，長停留下材料變化又可能使原驗證失效；未明示此界線會造成錯誤信心。~Treating information latency as permissible engineering delay confuses monitoring ability with ground tolerance. Material changes during a long hold can also invalidate earlier verification, creating false confidence if that boundary is unstated.
units.misconception: 資料傳輸延遲就是地層可以安全等待處置的時間。~Data transmission latency is the time the ground can safely wait for intervention.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄停留情境與既定回應的資料來源與適用條件。審查停留期間所需的連續觀測與備援通訊，演練責任人接收、核對和升級流程；正式停留、復工或維護仍依個案核准方案，不能由算例延遲自行制定時間限制。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for hold scenarios and predetermined responses. Review continuous observations and backup communication during holds and rehearse acknowledgment and escalation; stopping, restarting and maintenance remain governed by the approved project plan, not a limit derived from illustrative data latency.

units.anchor: 介面證據與接管~Interface evidence and takeover
units.title: 介面證據與接管~Interface evidence and takeover
units.mechanism: 始發到達完成後仍需查核井口、接縫和鄰近地層的延時反應，過渡成功不等於永久止水自動合格。交接要分開暫時與永久系統，保存屏障變更和量測歷程，讓營運方明白剩餘責任。 假設10項永久交接條件有9項完成，90%不能取代尚未驗證的1項止水介面；逐項審查優先於平均。 臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。~After launch or reception, delayed shaft, joint and ground response still needs review. A successful transition does not automatically qualify permanent waterproofing; separate temporary and permanent systems and retain barrier changes and monitoring for operational handover. If 9 of an assumed 10 permanent handover conditions are complete, 90% cannot substitute for one unverified sealing interface; individual review takes precedence over the average. Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete. Missing treatment changes on as-builts also prevent future diagnosis from locating the real interface.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10項永久交接條件有9項完成，90%不能取代尚未驗證的1項止水介面；逐項審查優先於平均。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 10 permanent handover conditions are complete, 90% cannot substitute for one unverified sealing interface; individual review takes precedence over the average.
units.verify: 對照竣工幾何、永久止水試驗、地層監測和異常處置，將臨時設備移除後的邊界另行確認；土建、設備、地工及業主共同簽認接管條件，不把施工節點完成當全案性能證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。~Reconcile as-built geometry, permanent sealing tests, ground monitoring and responses and confirm boundaries after temporary equipment removal; civil, equipment, geotechnical and owner leads jointly approve takeover rather than equating a construction milestone with full performance. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete. Missing treatment changes on as-builts also prevent future diagnosis from locating the real interface.
units.failure: 臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。~Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete. Missing treatment changes on as-builts also prevent future diagnosis from locating the real interface.
units.misconception: 始發到達成功就代表拆除臨時密封後永久止水也已合格。~Successful launch or reception proves permanent sealing after temporary barriers are removed.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄介面證據與接管的資料來源與適用條件。對照竣工幾何、永久止水試驗、地層監測和異常處置，將臨時設備移除後的邊界另行確認；土建、設備、地工及業主共同簽認接管條件，不把施工節點完成當全案性能證明。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for interface evidence and takeover. Reconcile as-built geometry, permanent sealing tests, ground monitoring and responses and confirm boundaries after temporary equipment removal; civil, equipment, geotechnical and owner leads jointly approve takeover rather than equating a construction milestone with full performance.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以始發到達介面、地層水文和暫態受力驗證止水轉換需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why verify launch and reception sealing transitions through interfaces, hydrogeology and temporary load paths requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition.

教學量化備忘：假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation.

教學量化備忘：假設串聯兩層各厚1 m，k1=10⁻⁶、k2=10⁻⁸ m/s，法向等效k=2/(10⁶+10⁸)=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s；旁通不適用。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume two 1 m layers in series with k1=10⁻⁶ and k2=10⁻⁸ m/s; normal equivalent k=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s, excluding bypass paths.

教學量化備忘：假設水頭差10 m、有效路徑5 m，i=2；若裂縫路徑僅1 m則i=10，未計三維流場。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume head difference 10 m over effective path 5 m, giving i=2; a 1 m crack path gives i=10, before three-dimensional flow effects.

教學量化備忘：假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing.

教學量化備忘：假設穿越長10 m、角偏0.2°，側向偏差10tan0.2°=34.91 mm；非允許偏角。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed crossing length 10 m and angular error 0.2°, lateral deviation is 10tan0.2°=34.91 mm, not an allowable angle.
